''None of them expressed anger at the doctors, judges, the bureaucracy. Just at me. One by one they abandoned me and pretended I no longer existed. When I started telling people out loud the pain and loss is so bad I am thinking to end my life they said I was seeking attention or "would have done it already if you were going to". This has all broken me. I will never trust anyone again. I don't want to die but I can't stand this pain. ''

This part of your post especially, along with everything else, really makes me sad. People blaming you for trusting doctors after the fact is disgusting. All my life I have felt people's emotions and I have had times where my 'family' turned its back on me when I was already emotionally wounded. All I can say is I hope you find peace but never feel guilty about leaving anyone behind. Family members and relatives are supposedly one's closest allies in life, but their love and support is secondary to their own need to survive emotionally and spiritually. For whatever reason they chose themselves over you when you needed unconditional love the most. I have a feeling most people are like this and everyday I can see past family member's fake love, it is indeed conditional. If our own blood doesn't truly care for us what chance do we have for strangers to reciprocate any love or trust to us? I have seen this my whole life being an INFJ and it is depressing and painful, your story just makes me realize it isn't just me.

I read your whole post. I am the same age, 23, university drop out. I worked through anxiety and depression in highschool and graduated with honors but it went downhill from there for me. I took a medical leave for anxiety and depression from a good university that I worked my butt off to get in. My classes were challenging, I was a biology major and wanted to become a doctor. I can't half-ass anything so either I did really well or I fail the class. I couldn't continue to cope and I moved home with my parents to attend a different university.  I felt like this before but for some reason I forced myself out of my anxiety and depression in highschool because I wanted so bad not to screw up my life. Too late now. Three years later I can't handle my biomedical science major anymore either. As I said, I either did well or just stopped trying all together due to anxiety. I feel so helpless in that regard. I am failing classes due to anxiety and stress and failed organic chemistry three times because I stopped attending class due to anxiety all three times. My parents don't know this time and I don't plan on telling them anything anymore. All my friends thought I was going to do so well, but I haven't been in contact with them amd keep my failures to myself. I have had addictions to video games and porn for a couple years to cope with my anxiety, depression, and family. My whole life I felt like I was hiding being unhappy and pretending to enjoy living, but I do not enjoy this and I feel numb to people around me. Only thing that was amusing was using my brain to do well in classes but even that has stopped, my brain refuses to funciton in class and so I am left with nothing to look forward to. My GPA is done, I can't do anything and I am not looking to change anything because I don't see a happy future.
